newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran says Taleban smuggling in Afghan illegals.
newsitem.headline: Iran says Taleban smuggling in Afghan illegals.

text.p: Iran has accused Afghanistan's Islamic Taleban militia of smuggling Afghan illegal immigrants into Iran for a fee, a newspaper said on Tuesday.

The daily Ettelaat quoted Mehdi Hosseini, Iran's top immigration official, as saying the Taleban were charging the illegals the equivalent of up to 800,000 Iranian rials ($267) each to take them over the border.

Iranian authorities had in the past few months broken up at least five Afghan gangs specialising in smuggling people over the border, he said. He did not say how many illegals were allegedly involved.
Hosseini said the Taleban were also refusing to cooperate in a programme to repatriate some 300,000 of the more than one million Afghan refugees living in Iran.

Iran recognises the government of ousted Afghan President Burhanuddin Rabbani. Iranian media have blasted the Taleban as being set up by Pakistan and backed by Washington. Pakistan denies the charge. ($1=3,000 rials at the official exchange rate)
